items.title: 英偉達調查執行長黃仁勳與涉嫌中國間諜的關係

items.titleZh: 英偉達調查執行長黃仁勳與涉嫌中國間諜的關係
items.summaryEn: Huang told Nvidia staff in an email that he had an affair and that the company's board has opened an investigation into allegations the woman is a Chinese spy.
